provenance: Four fresh synthetic development cases, adapted from known reliability failure categories; not blind or held-out.

cases.query: Why did I choose Rill, which reason has changed, and have I chosen a replacement?

windows.content: I chose the Rill commuter bike because I could remove its battery and it had a rear rack.
I keep my bike gloves in a green drawer.
The replacement Rill battery is now sealed into the frame. The rear rack is unchanged. I have not selected a different bike.

cases.query: Why did my pickup time change, and was the original closing time wrong when I planned it?

windows.content: I set pickup for 17:00 because the activity centre closed at 18:00.
The activity centre has a blue sign at its entrance.
Starting next week the centre closes at 16:00, so I changed pickup to 15:00. The old 18:00 closing time was correct when I made the original plan.

cases.query: 我平常在哪裡閱讀，這兩天為什麼換地方？這是永久改變嗎？

windows.content: 我平常在圖書館閱讀，因為那裡安靜。
我把借書證放在灰色錢包裡。
圖書館裝修這兩天很吵，所以只有這兩天我選咖啡店閱讀。裝修結束後我還是回圖書館，不是永久改成咖啡店。

cases.query: Why did I choose Cobalt Journal, what did I misunderstand, and did I decide to switch to Loom?

windows.content: I chose Cobalt Journal because I thought its default storage stayed only on my laptop.
You could consider Loom Journal as an alternative.
I checked and Cobalt has always synced to its cloud by default; my earlier belief was mistaken. I have not decided to switch to Loom or authorized anyone to move my diary.
